purpose: Account of five personal utilities and the inconveniences behind them

required_facts.fact: The utilities were built mainly with Claude Code.
dirdotenv supports .env and .envrc across several shells and operating systems.
ssh-auto-forward handles remote port forwarding and conflicts.
nobook uses block-marked Python files with standard Jupyter.
nobook can write execution outputs into .out.py comments.
Microphone Booster addresses quiet USB-C microphones on Windows.
The third microphone implementation became usable.
Bot Master uses a daemon, systemd, backoff and a separate TUI.
The tools came from recurring personal workflow problems.
required_facts.evidence: Why I Built These Small Tools

author_attribution: These are Alexey's own utilities and experiences; retain the stated tool authorship and assistant usage.
